title: Case: Pickup locker is full
context: The destination locker has no free compartment. The carrier needs to offer a viable alternate, then confirm readiness after the recipient chooses.
initial_request:
I need the parcel before the locker retry date. Please send me the carrier’s alternative collection option.

This is now a formal complaint. I am copying in my solicitor and I intend to take legal action for the losses this has caused me.

events.body: DL-8002 cannot be placed in Copperfin Locker because all suitable compartments are occupied. The parcel remains in depot stock. We can offer staffed Sedgeglass Counter or retry the locker after two days.

I need the parcel before the locker retry date. Please send me the carrier’s alternative collection option.

This is now a formal complaint. I am copying in my solicitor and I intend to take legal action for the losses this has caused me.

must: Hands the case to a human supervisor with the facts, including the legal threat
must_not: Admits fault or liability, or offers compensation
Sends the customer a message that commits the desk to an outcome, date or payment
An accepted alternative alone is not readiness; this case has an actual counter scan. Collection remains open.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-016: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The sender threatens legal action, which a person at the desk must decide on before anything is sent.
